links.text:
we announced Jev 1.14 on 10.14 at 1:14pm PT 🔥

a new and improved model, along with experimental features for our dreamers:

• images
• a new box type
• longer context

surprise, Jev was already able to see you! 👁️  

BUT our bar for production-grade intelligence is quite high, so builders beware, these are preview features.

enter the ~*~ danger zone ~*~ at your own risk. 🚨
